purpose: Test the index-parity lemma against every genuinely reconstructed census row, while keeping the withdrawn 88-row proxy population outside the theorem test.

population.test_rows: every row with odd genuine Shintani index greater than one
population.historical_88_row_proxy_population: excluded from the theorem test because all 88 finite moduli were proved conjugation-unstable

independence.index_side: re-read and hash every per-case genuine reconstruction transcript; parse DERIVED_SUBGROUP_ORDER rather than trusting the aggregate histogram alone
independence.support_side: use the exact W1 Fourier computation, which the R-13 scope audit established as proxy-free
independence.identity_test: the sign class is trivial exactly when every coordinate in sign_log is zero

acceptance_criteria: all 8200 transcript hashes match the genuine ledger
every transcript-derived index equals its ledger value
every odd genuine index greater than one has trivial sign_log
every odd genuine index greater than one has support_count zero and empty support_orders
failure_action: Any exception withdraws Lemma 2 and the abstract parity claim pending mathematical diagnosis.
